title: Snowman with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='94' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#3b4a66'/>
  <!-- bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='18' fill='#e8f2ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#b9cfe8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='14' fill='#f4f9ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#c6d9ee' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='11' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#cddff2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x='38' y='42' width='24' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <path d='M60 44 L68 46 L66 58 L60 56 Z' fill='#ff7a7a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='41' width='24' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff9a9a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='29' r='1.8' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='29' r='1.8' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 35 Q50 41 56 35' fill='none' stroke='#2a3550' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <path d='M50 32 L58 34 L50 36 Z' fill='#ff9f2e'/>
  <path d='M50 32 L58 34 L50 36 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ffc46b' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='2' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='2' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <!-- stick arms -->
  <path d='M36 52 L20 42 M20 42 L16 38 M20 42 L18 48' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M64 52 L80 42 M80 42 L84 38 M80 42 L82 48' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- hat -->
  <rect x='38' y='12' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a4a70'/>
  <rect x='42' y='2' width='16' height='11' rx='2' fill='#4a5c88'/>
  <rect x='42' y='2' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6a7ca8'/>
</svg>
